items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: He was a violinist and a very extremely popular character in New Orleans history.

ctx.x: Well, this is Tim Kelly again, the second reel. And we got to talking about Kelly and how the great musicians were attracted, you were saying. And I never didn't know anything about Max Fink, at least I didn't remember. Well, he was

before your time. He was a violinist and a very extremely popular character in New Orleans history. Played in the theaters and played for all the carnival balls and things like that. Well, Ted Frank, yes. I loved Ted Frank and I knew his father before him. And Dave who established the sheet meat business at Welland.
